EM_PUZZLE_TRAP_TILES.Name: Dorman Lakely's Puzzle and Trap Tiles

SequenceStep.Name: Switch: Sequence Step
SequenceStep.Help: Check if this switch is being activated in the correct order

CheckSequence.Name: Switch: Check Sequence Complete
CheckSequence.Help: Check if the entire switch sequence has been completed

ResetSequence.Name: Switch: Reset Sequence
ResetSequence.Help: Reset the switch puzzle to the beginning

ApplyDamage.Name: Apply Damage
ApplyDamage.FormulaHelp: Plain dice formula, e.g. 2d6 or floor((2d6) / 2). Do not use inline-roll brackets.
ApplyDamage.AutomateHelp: Roll and post the damage but leave hit points alone when unchecked. When checked, damage is applied through midi-qol if it is installed, honouring your Auto Apply Damage setting; otherwise it goes straight to the actor.
ApplyDamage.PropertiesHelp: Comma-separated bypass properties, used to punch through resistance to nonmagical or non-silvered attacks. Available: {properties}
ApplyDamage.PropertiesHelpEmpty: Comma-separated bypass properties. The current game system does not define any.

ApplyCondition.Name: Apply Condition
ApplyCondition.ExhaustionLevelHelp: Only used when the condition is Exhaustion. 1 to {max}.
ApplyCondition.DurationValueHelp: How many rounds, turns, minutes or hours the condition lasts. Ignored when the duration is "Until removed". Rounds and turns only tick during combat; minutes and hours tick with world time.

UseActivity.Name: Use Activity
UseActivity.ActivityHelp: Any activity on any of the actor's items — attack, save, damage, heal, or a check for spotting or disarming the trap.
UseActivity.FastForwardHelp: Roll straight away instead of opening the activity dialog.

saveDC.label: DC
saveDC.hint: The DC to beat. A plain number, or a formula such as 10 + 1d4.

saveAbility.label: Saving Throw
saveAbility.hint: Ability saving throws the creature may attempt. Offering more than one lets the player choose.

skillChecks.label: Skill Checks
skillChecks.hint: Used instead of a saving throw when no ability is chosen. Offering more than one lets the player choose.

damage.label: Damage
damage.hint: Damage rolled when the save fails.

savedDamage.label: Damage if Saved
savedDamage.hint: Damage rolled when the save succeeds. Leave blank for no damage on a successful save.

damageType.label: Damage Type
damageType.hint: The type of damage dealt, so resistance and immunity apply.

properties.label: Bypasses
properties.hint: Damage bypass properties such as magical or silvered, so the trap cuts through matching resistance.

automateDamage.label: Apply Damage
automateDamage.hint: Apply the rolled damage to the creature. Untick to roll it publicly and adjudicate by hand.

saveFailedMessage.label: Failed Message
saveFailedMessage.hint: Chat message posted when the save fails. {name}, {damage} and {type} are substituted.

saveSucceededMessage.label: Success Message
saveSucceededMessage.hint: Chat message posted when the save succeeds. {name}, {damage} and {type} are substituted.

triggerBehaviorOnSave.label: Trigger on Save
triggerBehaviorOnSave.hint: Other region behaviors to run when the save succeeds.

triggerBehaviorOnFail.label: Trigger on Fail
triggerBehaviorOnFail.hint: Other region behaviors to run when the save fails.

Trap.ChooseAbility: Choose which ability to make the save with.
Trap.ChooseSkill: Choose which skill to make the check with.
Trap.DefaultFailedMessage: {name} triggered a trap and took {damage} {type} damage!
Trap.DefaultSucceededMessage: {name} avoided the worst of a trap.

elevation.label: Elevation
elevation.hint: The elevation tokens are moved to.

soundPath.label: Sound File
soundPath.hint: The audio file to play for everyone at the table.

movementActions.label: Movement Actions
movementActions.hint: Only these ways of moving trigger the behaviors this filter guards. A flying creature can cross a pressure plate untouched.

gateKey.label: Filter Key
gateKey.hint: Links this filter to the behaviors it guards. Set automatically; change it only if you know what you are doing.

tileIds.label: Tiles
tileIds.hint: Ids of the tiles on this scene to trigger.

EMPUZZLES.CreateSwitchDesc: Interactive switch with ON/OFF states and variable tracking
EMPUZZLES.CreateResetTileDesc: Reset tiles, variables, and states back to their initial values
EMPUZZLES.CreateLightDesc: Toggleable light source with click or darkness trigger
EMPUZZLES.CreateTeleportDesc: Teleport tile that moves tokens to another location or scene
EMPUZZLES.CreateElevationDesc: Region that changes token elevation on enter and exit
EMPUZZLES.ElevationOnEnterHint: The elevation to set when a token enters the region
EMPUZZLES.ElevationOnExitHint: The elevation to set when a token exits the region (typically 0 to return to ground level)
EMPUZZLES.CreateDifficultTerrainDesc: Region that slows (or speeds) each way of moving through it
EMPUZZLES.TerrainCostHint: A cost multiplier for each way of moving. 1 is normal, 2 is classic difficult terrain (every foot costs two), 0.5 is a road. Set them separately and the region only bites the creatures it should: mud at walk 3 and fly 1 is a slog on foot and nothing to a flier.
EMPUZZLES.TerrainStackingHint: Overlapping cost regions multiply. Two regions that each cost 2 make the squares they share cost 4, not 3.
EMPUZZLES.TerrainRangeHint: Foundry stores costs between 0 and 5 in quarter steps, and silently rounds anything else. There is no "impassable" value — 5 is the slowest it can express. To stop movement outright, use a wall.
EMPUZZLES.TerrainDerivedActionsHint: Crawling, climbing, jumping and teleporting are not listed because Foundry works them out from the ones that are.
EMPUZZLES.CreateDarknessDesc: Region that darkens or brightens the light inside it
EMPUZZLES.DarknessModeHint: How this region changes the scene's darkness inside its bounds.
EMPUZZLES.DarknessModeDarkenHint: adds darkness on top of the scene's own. A modifier of 1 is pitch black whatever the time of day.
EMPUZZLES.DarknessModeBrightenHint: takes darkness away. A modifier of 1 is full daylight inside the region.
EMPUZZLES.DarknessModeOverrideHint: sets the darkness to exactly the modifier, ignoring the scene entirely.
EMPUZZLES.DarknessModifierHint: 0 to 1. With Darken or Brighten this is how far toward pitch black or full light the region pushes; with Override it is the darkness level itself.
EMPUZZLES.DarknessStackingHint: Darken and brighten regions compose: overlap two darken-0.5 regions and the overlap is darker than either alone, and neither can push past full dark. Override does not compose — overlapping override regions fight over the same area.
EMPUZZLES.CreateSurfaceDesc: Illusory floor, ceiling or catwalk you can switch off
EMPUZZLES.SurfacePresetHint: A starting point. Every switch below stays editable — change one and the preset reads Custom.
EMPUZZLES.SurfacePresetIllusoryFloorHint: a floor that looks and acts solid. Cover a pit with it, let the party walk across, then disable the region and everyone standing on it falls through.
EMPUZZLES.SurfacePresetSolidCeilingHint: a roof over the space below: blocks light, movement, sight and sound, fades the tiles above anyone underneath, and hides tokens that are not on the level you are looking at.
EMPUZZLES.SurfacePresetGlassFloorHint: solid underfoot and it stops sound, but light and line of sight pass straight through, so the party can see what waits below them.
EMPUZZLES.SurfacePresetCustomHint: whatever you set the switches to.
EMPUZZLES.SurfacePlacementHint: Whether the surface sits at the bottom of the region, the top, or both. A floor is a bottom; a ceiling is a top.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceBottomElevationHint: The height the lower surface sits at, in scene units. 0 is ground level.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceTopElevationHint: The height the upper surface sits at, in scene units. Only used when the placement includes a top.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceRestrictionsHint: Each switch is independent, so a surface can stop feet without stopping eyes.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceLightHint: Light does not pass through the surface.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceMoveHint: Tokens cannot cross the surface — this is what makes a floor a floor.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceSightHint: Nobody can see through the surface.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceSoundHint: Sound does not carry through the surface.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceOcclusionHint: Tiles set to Surface occlusion fade out when a visible token is below this surface, so the party is not hidden under the roof art.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceExposureHint: Shows part of an elevated surface to anyone below and outside it — useful for balconies and rooftops seen from the street.
EMPUZZLES.SurfaceCullingHint: Hides uncontrolled tokens that are not on the level you are currently viewing.
EMPUZZLES.RegionNameHint: A descriptive name for this region
EMPUZZLES.TileImageHint: The image displayed for this tile
EMPUZZLES.CustomTagsHint: Add custom tags for organizing tiles. An auto-generated tag (e.g., EM-Teleport-001) will also be applied after creation for tile management.
EMPUZZLES.HiddenTileHint: When checked, the tile will be hidden from players
EMPUZZLES.TargetSceneHint: The scene where the teleport destination is located
EMPUZZLES.SelectPositionHint: Click the button and then click on the canvas to select a teleport destination
EMPUZZLES.CrossSceneTeleportWarningHint: A Gamemaster user must be logged in for cross-scene teleportation to work.
EMPUZZLES.DeleteSourceTokenHint: When teleporting to a different scene, delete the token at the source location.
EMPUZZLES.DeleteSourceCombatWarningHint: Using Delete Source Token during combat will corrupt the initiative tracker. The initiative is tied to the original token, which will be deleted. Avoid using this option during active combat encounters.
EMPUZZLES.CreateReturnTeleportHint: Automatically create a 1x1 return teleport tile at the destination that brings tokens back to this location with the same settings
EMPUZZLES.CreateTrapDesc: Create trap tiles with damage, teleport, effects, or activate other tiles
EMPUZZLES.TrapTypeHint: Choose between an image-based trap or a trap that activates other tiles
EMPUZZLES.DMGTrapDropZone: Drag a DMG trap item here from a compendium
EMPUZZLES.DMGTrapItemHint: Drag a trap equipment item from a compendium (e.g., Poisoned Darts, Collapsing Roof) to automatically populate saving throw and damage fields based on level range
EMPUZZLES.AttackItemHint: Drag a weapon or feature from a compendium to use for this trap's attacks
EMPUZZLES.TokenVisibleHint: When checked, the trap will have a visible token on the map. When unchecked, the token will be hidden.
EMPUZZLES.TokenImageHint: Custom image for the trap's token (only used if token is visible)
EMPUZZLES.NoTokenPositionSelected: No position selected. The token will be placed at the tile location. Click the button to set a custom position.
EMPUZZLES.MaxTriggersHint: Number of times this trap can trigger (0 = unlimited, 1 = once, 2+ = that many times)
EMPUZZLES.TrapNameHint: A descriptive name for this trap tile
EMPUZZLES.TriggeredImageHint: The tile image shown after the trap is triggered (only used if hide trap is not checked)
EMPUZZLES.MinRequiredHint: Minimum number of tokens required to trigger the trap
EMPUZZLES.HasSavingThrowHint: When checked, targets must make a saving throw before the result is applied
EMPUZZLES.SavingThrowHint: The type of saving throw required to avoid the trap
EMPUZZLES.SavingThrowUnavailableHint: Install and enable Monk's Token Bar to use saving throw mechanics for traps and teleports. All other features will work without it.
EMPUZZLES.DCHint: The DC for the saving throw/ability check
EMPUZZLES.DamageOnFailHint: Damage dealt to tokens that fail the saving throw (e.g., 2d6, 3d8+5)
EMPUZZLES.HalfDamageOnSuccessHint: Tokens that succeed on the saving throw take half damage (rounded down)
EMPUZZLES.HealFlavorTextPlaceholder: You feel a surge of healing energy!
EMPUZZLES.AdditionalEffectsHealHint: Select additional status effects to apply when healing is triggered
EMPUZZLES.FlavorTextHint: Descriptive text shown when the trap is triggered
EMPUZZLES.SoundHint: Sound effect played when the trap is triggered
EMPUZZLES.ResultTypeHint: The type of result that occurs when the trap is triggered
EMPUZZLES.TargetTypeHint: Who is affected by the trap result
EMPUZZLES.PauseGameOnTriggerHint: When checked, the game will pause when this tile triggers. Useful for important narrative moments or giving the GM time to react.
EMPUZZLES.DeactivateAfterTriggerHint: When checked, this trap will automatically deactivate after being triggered once, making it a one-time trap
EMPUZZLES.VisibilityVisibleHint: The trap tile is visible to all players from the start
EMPUZZLES.VisibilityHiddenHint: The trap tile is hidden from players initially
EMPUZZLES.OnTriggerStaysSameHint: Tile image stays the same when triggered
EMPUZZLES.OnTriggerSwitchesImageHint: Tile changes to a different image when triggered
EMPUZZLES.OnTriggerStaysHiddenHint: Tile stays hidden even after being triggered
EMPUZZLES.OnTriggerRevealsSameHint: Tile becomes visible when triggered, keeping the same image
EMPUZZLES.OnTriggerRevealsSwitchedHint: Tile becomes visible when triggered and changes to a different image
EMPUZZLES.AdditionalEffectsDamageHint: Select additional status effects to apply on a failed saving throw
EMPUZZLES.AdditionalEffectsCombatHint: Select additional status effects to apply after the attack roll
EMPUZZLES.NoPositionSelected: No position selected. Click the button and then click on the canvas to select a teleport destination.
EMPUZZLES.EffectSelectHint: Select which status effect to apply from the available effects in your game system
EMPUZZLES.EffectActionHint: How to apply the effect (Add = apply, Remove = clear, Toggle = add or remove based on current state)
EMPUZZLES.ActivatingTrapTilesHint: Click Add Tile to select tiles from the canvas that will be activated when this trap is triggered
EMPUZZLES.VariableNameHint: Unique identifier for tracking this switch state
EMPUZZLES.LightSoundHint: Audio file for ambient sound at light location (leave blank for no sound)
EMPUZZLES.SoundRadiusHint: The radius in grid units for the ambient sound attenuation
EMPUZZLES.TeleportSoundHint: Played when a creature enters the teleport region. Regions only — tile teleports have no sound.
EMPUZZLES.SoundVolumeHint: The volume level for the ambient sound (0 = silent, 1 = full volume)
EMPUZZLES.UseDarknessTriggerHint: When enabled, the light will automatically activate based on scene darkness level instead of requiring a click
EMPUZZLES.DarknessMinimumHint: The minimum darkness level (0-1) at which the light will activate
EMPUZZLES.DimLightHint: The radius of dim light in grid units
EMPUZZLES.BrightLightHint: The radius of bright light in grid units
EMPUZZLES.LightColorHint: The color of the light (leave as #ffffff for white/natural light)
EMPUZZLES.ColorIntensityHint: The intensity/alpha of the light color (0 = transparent, 1 = opaque)
EMPUZZLES.UseOverlayHint: When enabled, an overlay tile (e.g., animated flame) will appear on top when the light is ON
EMPUZZLES.OverlayImageHint: The image or video for the overlay tile (typically an animated flame or glow effect)
EMPUZZLES.WallDoorActionsHint: Click Add Wall/Door to select walls or doors from the canvas to change their state
EMPUZZLES.NoWallsSelected: No walls/doors selected. Click "Add Wall/Door" to select walls or doors from the canvas.
EMPUZZLES.NoTilesSelected: No tiles selected. Click "Add Tile" to select tiles from the canvas.
EMPUZZLES.NoVariablesFound: No variables found in this scene.

EMPUZZLES.CreateCheckStateTileDesc: State machine that checks variables and branches logic
EMPUZZLES.CreateLockDesc: A locked door that only opens for whoever is carrying the key
EMPUZZLES.LockDoorHint: Click the door on the canvas. The lock only fires when someone tries a door that is still locked.
EMPUZZLES.LockWallIsNotADoor: this wall is not a door
EMPUZZLES.LockKeyItemHint: The exact item name on the character sheet. Wildcards * and ? are allowed, e.g. "* Key".
EMPUZZLES.LockCheckScopeToken: The token that tried the door
EMPUZZLES.LockCheckScopePlayers: Any player-owned token in the scene
EMPUZZLES.LockCheckScopeHint: The door trigger only sees selected tokens, so choose the scene-wide option if your players do not keep a token selected.
EMPUZZLES.LockDoorOnCreateHint: The lock can only fire on a door that is currently locked.
EMPUZZLES.LockDefaultSuccessMessage: The key turns and the lock gives way.
EMPUZZLES.LockDefaultFailureMessage: The lock holds fast. You will need a key.
EMPUZZLES.CreateCombinationDesc: Ask a question and act on the answer — keypad, riddle or password
EMPUZZLES.CombinationPromptHint: The question the players see. Plain text — Handlebars and inline rolls are stripped.
EMPUZZLES.CombinationAnswerHint: Leading and trailing spaces are ignored on both sides.
EMPUZZLES.CombinationCaseSensitiveHint: Off by default, so "OPEN" and "open" both count.
EMPUZZLES.CombinationMaxAttemptsHint: 0 or blank for unlimited. Once spent, the tile deactivates until you re-enable it.
EMPUZZLES.CombinationUnlockDoorHint: A correct answer unlocks this door as well as posting the message.
EMPUZZLES.CombinationDefaultPrompt: Three symbols are carved above the keyhole. What word do they spell?
EMPUZZLES.CombinationDefaultSuccessMessage: Something heavy shifts inside the mechanism.
EMPUZZLES.CombinationDefaultLockoutMessage: The mechanism grinds and seizes. It will not answer again.
EMPUZZLES.NotifyDoorTriggersDisabled: Monk's Active Tiles has door triggers turned off. Enable "Allow Door Trigger" in its settings or this lock will never fire.

EMPUZZLES.BranchesHint: Define conditional branches that execute actions when variable conditions are met. Branches are evaluated in order - first match wins.
EMPUZZLES.NoBranches: No branches defined. Branches allow you to execute actions based on variable conditions.
EMPUZZLES.NoConditions: No conditions. This branch will always match (default branch).
EMPUZZLES.DungeonMasterGuruTooltip: SRD rules and DM tools at dungeonmaster.guru
EMPUZZLES.ReportBugTooltip: Report a bug or request a feature on GitHub
EMPUZZLES.CreationTypeHint: Choose whether to create a Tile (uses Monk's Active Tiles) or a Region (uses FoundryVTT v13 native regions with Enhanced Region Behaviors)
EMPUZZLES.AllowChoiceHint: Prompt the user for confirmation before teleporting
EMPUZZLES.ReturnAllowChoiceHint: Prompt the user for confirmation before using the return teleport
EMPUZZLES.TriggerOnSaveHint: Behaviors to trigger when the save succeeds
EMPUZZLES.TriggerOnFailHint: Behaviors to trigger when the save fails
EMPUZZLES.TilesToTriggerHint: Monk's Active Tiles that will be triggered when the trap fires
EMPUZZLES.TriggerEventsHint: Pick every moment this trap should fire. They stack — choose Token Enter and Turn Start together and a lava pool burns anyone who walks in, then burns them again at the start of each of their turns.
EMPUZZLES.TriggerEventsTurnRoundHint: Turn and round triggers only work while a combat encounter is running. A turn trigger fires for the one creature whose turn it is. A round trigger fires for every creature standing in the region at once, so a party of four standing in the gas takes four lots of damage the moment the round ticks over.
EMPUZZLES.EventTokenTurnStart: Turn Start (the creature whose turn it is)
EMPUZZLES.EventTokenTurnEnd: Turn End (the creature whose turn it is)
EMPUZZLES.EventTokenRoundStart: Round Start (every creature in the region)
EMPUZZLES.EventTokenRoundEnd: Round End (every creature in the region)
EMPUZZLES.MovementActionsHint: Untick any way of moving that should not set this off — a pressure plate a flying creature glides over, or a rune that ignores anything teleporting past. Leave every box ticked and nothing is filtered. Turn and round triggers are never filtered, since no movement caused them.
EMPUZZLES.AutomateDamageHint: If enabled, the trap will automatically apply damage when triggered
EMPUZZLES.SaveAbilityHint: The ability used for the saving throw against the trap's damage. Takes priority over skill checks.
EMPUZZLES.SkillChecksHint: Alternative skill checks the user can choose from (Ctrl+click to select multiple)
EMPUZZLES.DamageOnSaveHint: Damage formula on successful save (leave empty for no damage on save)
EMPUZZLES.TileDamageTypeHint: Damage type applied to the token. Resistance, vulnerability and immunity are respected, and midi-qol handles the roll when it is installed.
EMPUZZLES.SaveFailedMessageHint: Message displayed when the saving throw fails
EMPUZZLES.SaveSuccessMessageHint: Message displayed when the saving throw succeeds

EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpWhatBody: Scene variables are values that are stored within a scene and persist between sessions. They're created and managed by Monk's Active Tiles.
EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpSwitchesBody: When you create a switch tile, it automatically creates a scene variable with an ON/OFF state. This variable can be referenced by name in other tiles' actions.
EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpReferenceBody: Use Handlebars syntax to reference variables in action fields:
EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpReferenceGet: - Gets the value of a variable
EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpCheckStateBody: Check state tiles monitor variables and execute different actions based on their values. They can be used to create complex conditional logic for puzzles.
EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpPatternDoors: Door States: Track if a door is open or closed
EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpPatternProgress: Puzzle Progress: Track which switches have been activated
EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpPatternEffects: Conditional Effects: Apply different effects based on game state
EMPUZZLES.VariablesHelpLearnMoreBody: For more information about Monk's Active Tiles and variables, see the Monk's Active Tiles documentation.

EMPUZZLES.DamagePropertiesHint: Mark the damage as magical, silvered or adamantine so it bypasses a creature that resists nonmagical or non-silvered attacks. Leave all unchecked for ordinary damage.
EMPUZZLES.ExhaustionLevelHint: How many levels of exhaustion the trap inflicts. Setting a level replaces the creature’s current exhaustion rather than adding to it.
EMPUZZLES.EffectDurationHint: How long the condition lasts. "Until removed" leaves it in place until someone clears it, which is how traps behaved before. Rounds and turns only count down during combat; minutes and hours count down with world time, so they also expire outside combat.

EMPUZZLES.CreateRotateDesc: Region that turns a room, bridge or corridor — walls, tiles, lights and everyone standing on it — with a switch to drive it
EMPUZZLES.RotateAnglesHint: Comma-separated angles in degrees the room stops at, e.g. 0, 90. The room starts at the first one and the switch steps through the list.
EMPUZZLES.RotateTimeHint: How long the turn takes. The system never animates faster than 500ms.
EMPUZZLES.RotateDirectionModeHint: Which way round the room travels to reach the next stop.
EMPUZZLES.RotateContentsHint: Select the walls, tiles, lights and sounds on the canvas before creating, and they will be carried round. Tokens standing in the region always come along and need no selection.
EMPUZZLES.RotateRefreshSelectionHint: Select objects on the canvas, then press this to pick them up without closing the dialog.
EMPUZZLES.RotateLinkWallsHint: Selecting one wall of a joined chain brings the whole chain round with it.
EMPUZZLES.RotateCreateSwitch: Create a switch tile that turns the room
EMPUZZLES.RotateCreateSwitchHint: Without a switch the room can only be turned from the region's own sheet.
EMPUZZLES.RotateSwitchModeHint: Whether each activation advances to the next stop angle or goes back to the previous one.
EMPUZZLES.RotateSwitchPrevious: Go back to the previous position
EMPUZZLES.CreateGasCloudDesc: Region that applies conditions while creatures are inside it — a cloud on the map, or an aura that follows a monster
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudModeHint: A cloud is drawn on the map and stays there. An aura is attached to a token and follows it.
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudModeCloud: Gas cloud — placed on the map
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudTokenHint: The token the aura follows. Deleting the token deletes the aura with it.
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudRangeHint: Radius in grid units (feet on a standard map), measured from the token.
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudExcludeToken: Leave the token's own square out
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudExcludeTokenHint: Useful when the creature is immune to its own stench.
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudGridBasedHint: Snaps the radius to the grid's own metric instead of a true circle.
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudConditionsHint: Applied when a creature enters and removed when it leaves. Only the effects this region applied are removed — conditions the party already had are left alone.
EMPUZZLES.GasCloudEffectUuidsHint: Optional. Comma-separated ActiveEffect UUIDs, for effects from a compendium or your own homebrew.
EMPUZZLES.NotifyRotateRequiresDnd5e: Dorman Lakely's Tile Utilities | Rotating rooms need the D&D 5e system — the Rotate Area region behavior it uses is provided by dnd5e 5.3 or later.
EMPUZZLES.NotifyRotateNameRequired: Please provide a name for the rotating room region.
EMPUZZLES.NotifyRotateAnglesRequired: A rotating room needs at least two stop angles, e.g. 0, 90.
EMPUZZLES.NotifyPlaceRotateRegion: Drag on the canvas to place the rotating region. Draw it centred on what should turn — its centre is the pivot. Press ESC to cancel.
EMPUZZLES.NotifyRotateRegionFailed: Dorman Lakely's Tile Utilities | Failed to create rotating room: {error}

EMPUZZLES.NotifyGasCloudTokenRequired: Please choose a token for the aura to follow.
EMPUZZLES.NotifyPlaceGasCloudRegion: Drag on the canvas to place and size the gas cloud. Press ESC to cancel.
EMPUZZLES.NotifyGasCloudFailed: Dorman Lakely's Tile Utilities | Failed to create gas cloud: {error}
EMPUZZLES.NotifyRegionBehaviorsNeedRestart: This version added new region behaviours, and Foundry only registers them when the server reloads the module list. Return to Setup and relaunch your world, then try again — otherwise the region would be created with none of its behaviours.
